Defines/redefines the term/s “clerical or typographical error"; “sex characteristics”;  andÂ  “intersex” [an umbrella term used to describe a wide range of innate bodily variations in sex characteristics.Â  Intersex people are born with physical sex characteristics such as sexual anatomy, reproductive organs, hormonal patterns, and/or chromosomal patterns) that do not fit the typical definition of male and female bodies.

States that “For intersex people, the correction of sex and/or first name shall be made de jure applicable due to the inborn nature of their medical condition; Provided, that they are of legal age.”

AN ACT AMENDING FURTHER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE
“DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990” AND
REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8551, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “PHILIPPINE NATIONAL
POLICE REFORM AND REORGANIZATION ACT OF 1998”
rows.abstract:
Proposes amendments to Sec.37 of R.A.No.6975 wherein Performance Evaluation System shall be administered in accordance with . . . and a code of conduct THAT MUST INCLUDE MORAL VALUES, SPIRITUAL PRINCIPLES AND BIBLICAN STANDARDS OF DISCIPLINE . . .

Provides that the evaluation system SHALL be administered in such a way as to foster the improvement of individual efficiency and behavioral discipline . . . , INDIVIDUAL HONESTY, INTEGRITY, LOYALTY TO THE CONSTITUTION AND RESPECT TO THE RULE OF LAW . . .

Proposes to include among the powers and functions of the Commission: the “CONDUCT MOTU PROPIO AN INVESTIGATION ON ANY POLICE UNIT FOUND INEFFICIENT OR INEFFECTIVE, AND IMPOSE THE CORRESPONDING SANCTIONS/S . . .; 
. . . THE PROGRAMS ON EDUCATION AND TRAINING SHALL INCLUDE VALUES FORMATION AS WEL AS MORAL AND SPIRITUAL DISCIPLINE; . . . AND REPORT SUCH PERFORMANCE (local chief executives) TO THE SECRETARY OF THE DILG AND TO THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT; Monitor and investigate MOTU PROPIO UPON COMPLAINT police anomalies and irregularities WHICH SHALL INCLUDE CRIMINAL ACTIVITIES.

Amends among others - general qualifications for appointment of an officer or member of the PNP: . . . AND MUST HAVE ATTENDED AT LEAST A CUMULATIVE TWENTY-FOUR (24) HOURS VALUES FORMATION PROGRAM . . . FOR THEIR MORAL AND SPIRITUAL FITNESS.

Proposes amendments regarding qualifications for promotion; and provides an explanation as to when an ADMINISTRATIVE CASE and CRIMINAL CASE IS CONSIDERED PENDING . . .

rows.author: E042;F062;I067;K104;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING FOREIGN INTERFERENCE IN THE PHILIPPINES AND CREATING THE COUNTER FOREIGN INTERFERENCE TASK FORCE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to penalize various methods whereby foreign agents and entities may interfere in the country´s political and governmental processes. Intends to safeguard national security and preserve democratic integrity by punishing individuals involved in malign actions serving foreign interests and prohibits support for foreign intelligence agencies to prevent their infiltration. 

Expands its scope to include harmful electronic communications and imposes obligations to internet service providers to block access to online messages that are prejudicial to national security and public safety. 

Proposes corresponding penalties to specific prohibited acts:Â  intentional foreign interference; ”¦ involving targeted persons; reckless foreign interference; ”¦ involving targeted persons/foreign intelligence/by electronic communications; preparing or planning a conspiracy to commit; ”¦ proposal to commit foreign interference. 

Seeks to create the Counter Foreign Interference Task Force composed of National Security Adviser, Sec. of Justice, COMELEC, DFA, DILG, DND, DTI, DICT, DSWD, CHED, AFP, PNP, PIA, and the AMLA Council-Secretriat. Proposes extraterritorial application to persons covered by this measure, and on the authority of the Anti-Money Laundering Council over suspects of any of the crimes defined under this Act. 

Refers to several related laws as follows:Â  “Anti-Wiretapping Law”; “Law on Secrecy of Bank Deposits,” as amended; “Foreign Currency Deposit Act”¦”, as amended; and “The General Banking Law of 2000”.

rows.abstract: Seeks to address thousands of aliens flocking to the country involved in Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs) that became closely linked to criminal activities that include ownership of land/s. The issue of illegal POGOs led to the review of existing policies against foreign land ownership, establishing the necessary framework for better enforcement and allocation for public use - any real property acquired through successful forfeiture proceedings. Proposes several manners in the disposal of the real estate property: for agricultural land - shall be distributed to qualified farmers in coordination with DAR; for non-agricultural land - for the establishment of schools, hospitals, and other establishments for socialized services; or may be donated to the LGUs for social services facilities or to be turned over to the Privatization and Management Office of the DOF.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2024-11-11

rows.author: F083;K072;K032;K063;G002;F027;K017;K016;K117;K011;G059;K083;K025;G066;
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING AND STRENGTHENING THE REGULATION OF COCKFIGHTING BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 449, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “COCKFIGHTING LAW OF 1974”, AS AMENDED, AND SECTION 4 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1802, ENTITLED “CREATING THE PHILIPPINE GAMEFOWL COMMISSION”, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Rationalizing And Strengthening The Regulation Of Cockfighting By Local Government Units, Further Amending For This Purpose Presidential Decree No. 449, Otherwise Known As The “ Cockfighting Law Of 1974 ”, As Amended, And Section 4 Of Presidential Decree No. 1802, Entitled “ Creating The Philippine Gamefowl Commission ”, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Aims to give local government units more teeth in regulating cockpits and cockfighting; empower LGUs to permit and regulate cockfighting during local fairs or expositions and special cockfighting during barangay fiesta to ensure the safety and well-being of the participants and the public and to allow the LGUs, including the barangay, to earn from them.
Prohibits gambling of any kind on the premises of the cockpit or place of cockfighting during cockfights.

rows.abstract:
Seeks to support the government´s effort to promote financial inclusion through providing the public especially the low-income Filipinos - with a seamless and convenient banking experience.

Defines “small-value transaction” as a transaction involving an amount of not more than one thousand pesos (P1,000.00).Â  States that if the total value of small-value electronic transactions exceeds ten thousand pesos (P10,000.00) in a day, the subsequent small-value transactions shall be subjected to fees.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ENSURING GENDER-RESPONSIVENESS IN NATURALIZATION LAWS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 15 OF COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 473, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "REVISED NATURALIZATION LAW" AND SECTION 12 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9139, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS "THE ADMINISTRATIVE NATURALIZATION LAW OF 2000"
rows.abstract:
Aims to ensure gender parity in our naturalization laws and to further enhance gender equality and equity.
Provides that any woman who is now or hereafter be married to a citizen of the Philippines, or who might herself be lawfully naturalized shall have the option to become a citizen of the Philippines or retain her citizenship.
Provides that if the applicant is a married woman, the approval of her petition for administrative naturalization will give her alien husband the option to become a Filipino citizen if he is otherwise qualified for naturalization or otherwise retain his citizenship.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT SYSTEM
rows.abstract:
Seeks to resolve confusions and disagreements among project proponents, agencies, non-government organizations and other stakeholders resulting in the interpretation of PD 1586 of 1978 or the Philippine Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) System.
Establishes the Environmental Assessment System (EAS) which shall cover Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) and Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). The EAS shall be implemented for identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and managing any policy, plan, or program which has the potential for significant adverse impact on the environment.
Retains, but streamline and rationalize, the current EIS System for projects deemed critical or tend to pose significant adverse impact on the environment such as heavy industries, major manufacturing industries, major resource-extractive and -intensive industries, and major infrastructure projects.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-12-17, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-12-18 and received by the Senate on 2024-12-18

AN ACT PROPOSING AMENDMENTS ON REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11032, OTHERWISE
KNOWN AS THE EASE OF DOING BUSINESS AND EFFICIENT GOVERNMENT SERVICE
DELIVERY ACT OF 2018 FOR FURTHER EXPANSION OF ITS JURISDICTION AND OTHER
MECHANISM
rows.abstract:
Seeks to add definitions of Multi-stage System, Regulation, and Regulatory Management System; to add provisions regarding Multi-stage System as embodied in the IRR; to expand the Automatic Approval Mechanism; to expand Sec.11 in mandating streamlining procedures; to propose expansion of Anti-Red Tape Unit in the Civil Service Commission and Committee on Red Tape in covered government offices and agencies, etc.

Defines Multi-stage System as the system adopted by government agencies or offices in the delivery of their government services that are highly technical in nature which consists of multiple components or stages that are required to be undertaken by the government agency or office and/or by their applicant or requesting party to deliver or obtain the final document applied for or requested.Â  These stages involve activities such as, but not limited to, research, field trials, scientific methodology, and inter-government actions.
